title: The partial ARBITRATION_FANOUT_ACCOUNTS allowlist SUBTRACTS bybit_2 and bybit_portfolio from rounds they had already won — armed for one account, the fan-out is narrower than unarmed
note: OPERATOR-RAISED 2026-09-22, from the numbers: '200 trades on paper and one on money for the same time frame seems out of whack... We need to verify that and see why that is.' VERIFIED, THEY ARE RIGHT. [!] MEASURED BY THE MANAGER, population stated: the 200 most recent closed trades, closedAt 2026-09-13T20:55:29Z -> 2026-09-22T08:48:49Z (~9 days), restricted to the six legs bybit_2 was actually running (its pre-R2 roster), counted per account — bybit_1 12, bybit_2 1, bybit_portfolio 1. The MIRROR agreeing with bybit_2 rather than with bybit_1 is what ruled out a broker fault and pointed at routing. That is the 12/1/1 figure the lane's note below calls inherited: it is inherited from this measurement, not from prose. THE OPERATOR'S DIRECTIVE (2026-09-22) IS RECORDED IN THE MEMO VERBATIM AND NOTHING IN THE REPO STATED IT BEFORE: bybit_1 is the SOAK INSTRUMENT and must never constrain another account; bybit_2 (real money) and bybit_portfolio (its paper mirror) trade the same things; arbitration is per-ACCOUNT, scoped to the candidates THAT account is considering. [!] THE FINDING, AND IT IS NOT THE ONE THIS ROW WAS DISPATCHED ON. The starvation of bybit_2 is not only BL-20260827's global winner-per-symbol. It is a SECOND, NEWER mechanism: arming ARBITRATION_FANOUT_ACCOUNTS for bybit_1 ALONE made routing STRICTLY NARROWER THAN LEAVING IT UNARMED. pipeline.py:1087 dispatches the fan-out as `if _rounds: <per-round> else: <global>` -- it REPLACES the global dispatch -- and _attach_fanout_plan narrows every round through scope_round_to_accounts(r, allow), which INTERSECTS the round's accounts with the allowlist. So one surviving bybit_1 round suppresses the global dispatch for that tick and every non-allowlisted account in that round is DELETED from a dispatch the global path would have served. [!] MEASURED ON THE LIVE SOAK, locator: diag-request issue #12708, run 35695727461, read 2026-09-22T06:38:27Z, path log_file?name=arbitration_fanout_soak&lines=30. POPULATION, STATED: 11 complete rows + 1 truncated, 2026-09-21T14:52:12Z -> 21:17:33Z, ~6.4 HOURS -- NOT the ~9-day trade window the defect statement was measured over. The relay cut the container field at its 47739-byte budget. Positive control IS IN THE PULL: present true, size_bytes 1156308, rows parse, git_sha f3746abd1 == on-disk, restart_pending false. Every row carries fanout_schema 3, global_mode apply, apply_state dispatchable and a NON-EMPTY rounds_applied -- so the fan-out is not merely planning, IT IS THE LIVE DISPATCHER, and MI-286's projection defect is fixed and deployed. [!] THE ROW THAT SETTLES IT, 2026-09-21T20:30:08.586710Z ETHUSDT: accounts_planned 3, accounts_elected 3, elected_by_account = {bybit_1, bybit_2, bybit_portfolio} all -> trend_donchian_eth_4h, rounds_planned[0].accounts = [bybit_1, bybit_2, bybit_portfolio], rounds_written[0].accounts = [bybit_1], rounds_applied[0].accounts = [bybit_1]. The per-account election DID elect for real money and its mirror; the allowlist discarded them. The only thing between those two fields is scope_round_to_accounts. [!] REPRODUCED AGAINST THE REAL SOURCE (not re-typed), both branches, pinned in tests/test_arbitration_fanout_allowlist_scope.py, 8 passing. BEFORE/AFTER: on a co-election tick, unarmed -> bybit_2 ROUTED, allow={bybit_1} -> bybit_2 DROPPED, allow=all -> ROUTED. On a divergent tick (bybit_1 has 26 legs to bybit_2's 3, so this is the common case) the whole bybit_2 round returns None and vanishes while bybit_1's round still suppresses the global path. THE LIVE CONFIG IS THE ONLY ONE OF THE THREE THAT IS WORSE THAN DOING NOTHING. [!] WHY IT CLOSES THE 12/1/1 GAP: read from config/accounts.yaml, bybit_2 and bybit_portfolio run 3 legs (xrp_pullback_2h, trend_donchian_eth_4h, trend_donchian_xrp_4h) and ALL THREE are also on bybit_1's 26. So on EVERY tick bybit_2 has a candidate, bybit_1 has one too and one of the two branches fires: there is no tick on either of bybit_2's symbols on which the live config can dispatch it. bybit_portfolio is identical by CI construction, which is why the mirror agrees with bybit_2 rather than bybit_1 and why that agreement rules out a broker fault. [!] WINDOW BOUNDED, NOT DATED. The regression starts when MI-286's projection fix deployed (before it, accepted_rounds returned [] every tick and the pipeline always took the global else:). Its landing declaration is on main at or before 2026-09-17 -- the shallow-clone boundary this session could reach. I did NOT pin the deploy commit and the regression probably does NOT cover the earlier part of 2026-09-13->09-22; that part is BL-20260827. [!] SECOND DEFECT, FOUND ON THE WAY, NOT FIXED: on that same row starved_accounts is [] and starved_count is 0 WHILE TWO ACCOUNTS WERE DROPPED. arbitration_fanout.assess grades `starved` against the GLOBAL election and knows nothing of the allowlist, so starvation CAUSED BY THE FAN-OUT is invisible to starved_count and therefore to src/runtime/starved_account_alert.py. The only field pair that makes it sayable is rounds_planned vs rounds_written, and no alert reads it. Same class as E22/E31. Filed PI-20260922-FANOUT-STARVATION-INVISIBLE-TO-ASSESS. [!] PROPOSED, NOT LANDED (Tier 3). (a) get-env ARBITRATION_FANOUT_ACCOUNTS FIRST -- it is a CSV and EMPTY MEANS NONE -- then set-env the UNION with bybit_1,bybit_2,bybit_portfolio,breakout_1, service ict-trader-live, env_file shared. From the soak alone the live allowlist is known only to satisfy allow INTERSECT {bybit_1,bybit_2,bybit_portfolio,breakout_1} = {bybit_1}; it may hold Alpaca accounts this session cannot see, which is exactly why the read is not optional. (b) fix the scope in aggregate_intents so the election is per (symbol, account) at source. MY READ: the directive calls for BOTH, (b) is what 'obviously an incorrect application' means structurally and (a) is what 'immediately' means -- and (a) is not merely the fast path, because the live state is worse than unarmed. [!] I DELIBERATELY DID NOT WRITE (b)'S DIFF. plan_per_account_election's own docstring warns that re-running the aggregator per account re-emits a regime_hard_gate row per account per tick, corrupting the signal that partitions 'would have gated' from 'did gate' -- that is a design question, and shipping a diff I had not reasoned it through would be the improvisation E17 was told not to do. [!] THIRD OPTION, CHEAPEST, AND THE OPERATOR SHOULD BE OFFERED IT EXPLICITLY: set-env ARBITRATION_FANOUT_MODE=annotate. One variable, no roster question, returns routing to the global path -- strictly better than today for bybit_2 and no worse for anyone. It does not fix BL-20260827; it removes the regression while (b) is designed. [!] WHAT I COULD NOT DO, PLAINLY: issue_write returns 403 Resource not accessible by integration while issue_read on the same objects succeeds -- the write-scope boundary, not the transient token drop. SO I COULD NOT OPEN A FRESH DIAG-REQUEST and could not re-request the soak path alone for the untruncated tail; the measurement rests on rows recovered from the EXISTING #12708 comment. No file-drop relay exists for the live VM's diag surface (only the trainer VM), and https://ict-bot.duckdns.org/api/diag/* returns 401 without DIAG_READ_TOKEN, which this session does not hold. I also did NOT independently verify the 12/1/1 closed-trade split -- that needs /api/diag/audit_query behind the same relay; it is consistent with everything measured here but it is INHERITED, NOT RE-TAKEN. A session with a working issue_write should re-take ONE read -- log_file?name=arbitration_fanout_soak&lines=200 AS THE ONLY PATH IN THE ISSUE -- and count, over a stated window, rows where rounds_planned accounts strictly contain rounds_written accounts, and rows where a planned round was dropped entirely. [!] RELATION TO E17 (lane/e17-arm-arbitration-fanout-breakout1, blocked on the same 403): SAME VARIABLE, THIS ROW SUPERSEDES ITS FRAMING. E17 does not contradict this -- breakout_1 belongs in the union and (a) includes it -- but breakout_1 ALONE would not have helped bybit_2 or bybit_portfolio and would have left this regression running against real money. E17's own row says 'if it turns out the fanout runs and the record is merely missing, COME BACK, do not improvise'; the 2026-09-22 read established that it RUNS AND DISPATCHES, so that instruction is live. Its branch carries a checklist-note commit only -- no set-env, no code -- so nothing conflicts. RECOMMENDED DISPOSITION: fold E17 into this row's (a) as ONE wider set-env rather than two, because two sequential partial widenings mean an intermediate state in which some other account is the one being subtracted. [!] APPLIED AND VERIFIED ON THE RUNNING PROCESS, 2026-09-22, operator-approved twice. Sequence, each step with what it established: (1) READ FIRST, run 35718127262 -- ARBITRATION_FANOUT_ACCOUNTS process 'bybit_1', declared 'bybit_1', agreeing, no pending_restart. That resolved the lane's open caveat that the live allowlist might contain Alpaca accounts it could not see: it did not. (2) CHECKED BEFORE WRITING, because the memo's phrasing ('suppressed for that tick') would have implied cross-account contamination: pipeline.py computes _rounds = _fanout_apply_rounds(signal) PER SIGNAL, not per tick, so the suppression is scoped to one symbol's decision and Alpaca signals were never exposed to a Bybit round. (3) WRITE, run 35718253767 -- union to bybit_1,bybit_2,bybit_portfolio,breakout_1; .env updated; ict-trader-live.service restarted; Post-restart state active. (4) READ BACK, run 35718365883 -- process holds it. (5) OPERATOR EXTENDED IT ('yes, we need to add it for alpaca too'), run 35718739585, and the MANAGER WIDENED IT FURTHER TO ALL 11 ACCOUNTS -- stated as a judgement call, reversible with one set-env -- because a PARTIAL allowlist IS the defect: alpaca_live (3 legs, real money) has the identical shape to bybit_2 against alpaca_paper's 19-leg soak book, and ib_live/oanda_practice carry 0 legs so including them removes a latent hazard rather than creating one. Verified on the process, run 35718808115, process == declared, all 11. [!] DEPLOYED, NOT OBSERVED, AND THE DISTINCTION IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THIS ROW. CLOSING IT MEANS, IN ORDER: a soak row on an ETHUSDT/XRPUSDT tick where rounds_written[].accounts == rounds_planned[].accounts, AND THEN a JOURNAL ROW FOR bybit_2 -- per the soak's own docstring, 'a soak row alone proves the decision, never the order'. [!] AND THIS IS A MITIGATION, NOT THE FIX: it removes the SUBTRACTION introduced by the partial allowlist. It does NOT remove the global winner-per-symbol election underneath it, so bybit_2 can still lose a symbol to a bybit_1-only 5m leg in the divergent case. That is BL-20260827 and it is row E34. [!] MEASURED ON THE LIVE SOAK 2026-09-22 BY THE MANAGER, AND IT PROMOTES THE LANE'S SINGLE ROW TO A POPULATION.
